aggregation: Official definitions; missing tasks count as zero. Rounded only at final mean; official rounds individual tasks first.

metadata.notes: Qwen3-VL backbone frozen; audio tower last 8 layers plus connector/projection/adapter/prototype trained. Full MMEB-V3 190/190 evaluation.

metadata.training_data: VLM2Vec-V2 public training data sources: MMEB-train image; ColPali train set + VisRAG visual-document data; LLaVA-Hound video_caption_300k used for caption_retrieval and video_retrieval.
metadata.training_config: Late Interaction dimension=512; Batch Size=32, Gradient Accumulation=4, GPUs=2 A100s; training steps 4000; 8 frames/video; reduced video weights: video_caption_300k caption_retrieval=1.5, video_caption_300k-video video_retrieval=2.5; video_qa_240k disabled.
metadata.notes: Reduced video weight means total video block weight 4.0 in this run (1.5 + 2.5), not the original VLM2Vec-V2 video block weight 15. The video_qa_240k subset was not used.
